posts.text: Gas is over $4.50 per gallon, families are hurting and Republicans don’t give a damn.

Conservative extremists on the Supreme Court gave Donald Trump King-like immunity in 2024.

They are responsible for the unprecedented corruption he's unleashed on the country.

And now the American people are paying the price.

We will always stand with Stephen Colbert.

Video

Donald Trump pardoned hundreds of violent felons who brutally beat police officers on January 6th.

Now he wants to pay them with a nearly $2 billion slush fund using taxpayer money.

Everyone involved in this crooked scheme will be held accountable.

We will never surrender our freedom.

And always put the Constitution over the Cult.

Taxpayer dollars should make life more affordable for everyday Americans.

Not to line the pockets of the powerful and reward the violent mob from January 6 with a $1.8 billion slush fund.

Not for a lavish ballroom.

Not to fund masked ICE agents brutalizing citizens.

And not on a reckless war of choice in Iran.

Donald Trump has gotten America into a reckless and costly war of choice in the Middle East.

But Pete Hegseth has time to campaign in Kentucky for a MAGA puppet.

These extremists are all unfit to serve.

The level of corruption and illegality from the Trump administration and Republican Party shocks the conscience.

Note to right-wing extremists and sycophants.

The statute of limitations for felony crimes is five years.

Deeply disturbed by the shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego.

My prayers are with the victims, their families and the Clairemont community.

We must crush Islamophobia and the hatred that is fueling it.

Donald Trump and his congressional cronies have crashed the economy and dramatically increased the high cost of living.

Why aren’t MAGA extremists trying to fix the damage they have done?

Republicans are too busy corruptly lining their pockets and rewarding the violent mob they unleashed on January 6th.

Every single sycophant will be held accountable for this stunning abuse of power.

Democrats are fighting hard to make life more affordable. 

Meanwhile. 

Republicans are busy fighting each other and bending the knee.

The American people will decide who controls Congress in November. 

Not far-right extremists on the Supreme Court. 

Send them all a powerful message that enough is enough.

Republicans care more about war in the Middle East than making life affordable for the Middle Class. 

You deserve better.

The high cost of living is out of control and Republicans don’t give a damn.

Video

The ghosts of the confederacy have afflicted the Supreme Court.

And are haunting the nation.

Shameful.

Video

The reckless Republican war of choice in Iran is crushing the financial situation of the American people.

Donald Trump just made clear he doesn’t give a damn.

At what point have you had enough?
